name: Soyuz MS-14
about: Soyuz MS-14 (2019-055A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2019 Aug 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2019 Aug 24), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
